m: वाङ् in comp. for वाच्.
वाङ्गाली f. a partic. Rāgiṇī, ib.
वाङ्गाल m. (in music) a partic. Rāga, Saṃgīt.
वाङ्गारि m. patr. Pravar.
वाङ्ग m. a king of the Vaṅgas, VarBṛS. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 170, Sch.)
N. of a poet, Cat.
वाङ्गक m. a reverer of the Vaṅgas or of their king, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 100, Sch.
वाङ्क m. (cf. √ 2. वक्, and वङ्क) the ocean, sea, L.
वाङ्क्ष् (connected with √ वाञ्छ् cf. काङ्क्ष्) cl. 1. P. वाङ्क्षति, to wish, desire, long for, Dhātup. xvii, 17.
वाङ्—माधुर्य n. sweetness of speech or voice, ŚārṅgP.
वाङ्—माला f. N. of wk.
वाङ्—मात्र n. mere words, only sp˚, Hariv.
वाङ्—मूल mfn. having root or origin in sp˚, Mn. iv, 256.
वाङ्—मूर्ति mfn. having sp˚ for a body
वाङ्—मूर्ति f. (with देवता) Sarasvatī, Pracaṇḍ.
वाङ्—मधु n. pl. sweet words, Śak.
वाङ्—मधुर mfn. sweet in speech, speaking sweet words, Hit.
वाङ्—मनस् n. du. (KaṭhUp.; Mn.; Vās.) or वाङ्—मनस, n. (sg. [Pāṇ.; Vop.] or in comp. [Gaut.; Vedāntas.] or du. [MW.]) speech and mind.

m: वाङ्—मती f. N. of a sacred river, W.

m: वाङ्—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of speech, depending on sp˚, whose essence is sp˚, relating to sp˚ (also -त्व n.), ŚBr.; VS.; Prāt.; ChUp. &c.
eloquent, rhetorical, W.
वाङ्—मय n. sp˚, language, Kum.
eloquence, rhetoric, manner of sp˚, RPrāt.; Sāh. &c.
a: वाङ्मय — a. (यी f.) 1 Consisting of words; R. 3. 28. --2 Relating to speech or words; Ms. 12. 6; Bg. 17. 15. --3 Endowed with speech. --4 Eloquent, rhetorical, oratorical. --यं 1 Speech, language; म्यरस्तजभ्नगैर्लांतैरेभिर्दशभिरक्षरैः . समस्तं वाङ्मयं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यमिव विष्णुना Cand. M. 1; Ku. 7. 90; Śi. 2. 72. --2 Eloquence. --3 Rhetoric. --यी The goddess Sarasvatī.

m: वाङ्—मय—देवता f. the goddess of sp˚, Siṃhās.
वाङ्—मय—त्व n.
वाङ्—मय—विवेक m. N. of wk.
वाङ्—मिश्रण n. exchanging words, conversation with (instr.), Prab.
वाङ्—मुख n. the opening of a speech, an exordium, L.

m: वाङ्-निधन वाङ्-मती &c. See p. 937, cols. 1 and 2.
वाङ्—निधन mfn. having वाच् as the burden or refrain (in a recitation), Nid.; Lāṭy.
वाङ्—निधन n. (with क्रौञ्च n. or सौहविष n. N. of Sāmans.)
वाङ्—निश्चय m. settlement by word, affiance by word of mouth, marriage contract, MW.
